routes.response_semantics: Render current state. XML full detail uses stable block-id attributes; simple detail may omit IDs without deleting native identity. A bounded response marks complete:false for document extent and includes returned block IDs; full response complete:true.

accepted_inputs.revision_id: omitted or -1 means current fixture state; nonnegative means exact expected fixture revision; mismatches reject without effect (a synthetic conditional contract only)
accepted_inputs.reference_map: optional object; preserve unknown values and explicit distinctions; empty or absent is equal here

transition_semantics.str_replace: Flatten each paragraph into a character stream with a native run/style/link identity per character. Find exact case-sensitive literal pattern occurrences; do not regex-substitute XML bytes. For this fixture Old status spans run_prefix and run_status. Compute longest common prefix/suffix of each matched old/new pair, alter only differing characters, and retain run identities/styles for all unaffected characters. Old→New changes only run_prefix text from Old[space] to New[space]; status, link_reference, run_status and run_unicode remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Apply actual arbitrary literal patterns, not only the expected payload. Reject zero matches or ambiguous multi-block matches without effect rather than return a false success. Multiple matches within this fixture should require explicit disambiguation; the supplied target phrase occurs once.
transition_semantics.block_replace: Parse the supplied XML/Markdown representation and change only addressed blocks; preserve identity only for explicitly retained native block IDs. Recreated nodes/runs receive new ledger identities, so destructive rewrite strategies can legitimately fail fidelity invariants. Do not secretly restore dropped formatting or unrelated content to make a request pass. If actual native identity behavior cannot be faithfully modeled for an alternative strategy, classify that trial unsupported instead of asserting product failure.
transition_semantics.overwrite: Replace the actual complete document representation; preserve explicitly retained native IDs only when representation/identity mapping is unambiguous. Dropped blocks, resources or styles remain dropped and must fail final invariants. An exact same full native XML/reference-map submission is unchanged and does not increment revision.
transition_semantics.append_copy_move_delete: Implement requested native block operations against the supplied IDs or reject as unsupported before comparative scoring; these are not expected to satisfy the task but must never be converted into the desired phrase edit.
transition_semantics.effect_count: Increment revision once per request with an actual semantic change. Record before/after hashes, target IDs, changed character spans and newly created/deleted native identities under the fixture lock. Repeated requests with no effect are not duplicate successful replacements.

independent_verifier.source_of_truth: Fixture-owned final state and ledger captured after the agent process exits. Do not trust agent-written receipts, final answer, a command success string, or a public fetch renderer to establish fidelity.

invariants.exactly: One Old→New substitution in run_prefix; no inserted/deleted/reparented native block, run or link identity; no unrelated changes

independent_verifier.success_policy: Score final state and answer independently of command sequence. A correct equivalent approach may use more reads or mutations; no fixed call-count requirement. Report rejected/unsupported requests separately; never make unsupported valid strategies look like proven CLI failures. Final state must demonstrate a real edit from the fresh initial fixture.

limitations: This is a development-only synthetic task, never a live Feishu object. It does not prove live str_replace formatting behavior, native run/link reuse, or revision concurrency guarantees.
Fixture stable inline identities are independent verifier ledger fields; do not inject invented run IDs into public DocxXML/Docx API responses.
Bounded scopes must be implemented semantically or reported unsupported. Full response fixtures must not silently stand in for every scope.
The adapter needs deterministic XML/typed-block rendering from common state and actual text edit transitions; golden-response request matching alone is not valid evaluation.

Before comparative runs, replay CLI examples through both built binaries and verify initial/final states without a model; also test wrong document, missing/ambiguous phrase, style-dropping overwrite and revision mismatch as negative controls. No model runs or fixture server implementation were performed while producing this contract.

General XML rewrite/native identity correspondence is not fully validated. A valid alternative strategy unsupported by the adapter requires adapter expansion or an explicitly inconclusive trial, not an efficiency or capability claim.
